entities.description: A young boy with short, wavy brown hair sits on a beige couch, wearing a thick, light gray cable-knit sweater and blue jeans. He holds a black smartphone with both hands, looking down at the screen with a serious, furrowed-brow expression, while an adult's hand rests on his shoulder.

A woman with shoulder-length brown hair sits on a beige couch next to a young boy, wearing a dark blue blazer over a red t-shirt and blue jeans. She has a concerned expression with furrowed brows, looking down at a black smartphone held by the boy, while her left hand rests on his shoulder.

attributes.action: looking at phone, hand on boy's shoulder

entities.description: A light beige or taupe fabric sofa with a textured, woven appearance, featuring a thick, rectangular back cushion and a seat cushion that appears soft and slightly compressed under the weight of the people sitting on it.

attributes.cushions: thick, rectangular back and seat cushions
